arms.radius: BCE(base) + 1.0*(mean softplus(1-s*dF) over 750 flips + mean |dF| over 750 stays)

budget: 750 flip transitions each + same 512 base; radius stays are method-intrinsic (documented, not hidden)
eval: eval_202 dev: static/trans/comp/action (WP4-style) + R-shift per arm
model: CoordMLP(64,32) from scratch, Adam lr=1e-2, 300 epochs full-batch (r04b recipe)
pilot_gate: radius vs flipcov: mean dTrans<=-10pp AND 3/3 same direction AND static cost<=+2pp AND R_miss median moves toward 1.0; pass -> propose confirm (no auto-run); fail -> bury
train_data: train_101 states (mu/sd from train); 750+750 pairs subsampled from events_train.npz (fixed rng 7)
